js: 'The Chat in a narrow dashboard window (chat-plane design D37, §9.3): WebKit at the app\'s 125 %. At 880 px the window is under 1100 CSS px, so the sidebar is its rail and the Chat keeps 651 px: no drawers, the panels\' rails as before. At 700 px (560 CSS px, a 507 px Chat) the thread list and the thread\'s settings are drawers: the head\'s two buttons on the first line, each drawer laid over the conversation from its edge, one putting the other away, the fold button, Esc, a press in the conversation and a pick putting them away, and the dirty guard asking over an open settings drawer (Stay keeps the edit and the drawer, Leave and discard leaves and stores nothing). Writes: one thread and one message through the Chat. Run: scripts/webkit-check.py --backend broadway --zoom 1.25 --drive scripts/drive/chat-narrow.json --shots DIR --token <owner token> --base http://<addr> on a dev instance with the fake-echo alias (scripts/chat-actions-setup.sh); scripts/chat-drives.sh --webkit runs it.'

(() => { window.__tid = null; fetch('/chat/api/threads', {method: 'POST', headers: {'content-type': 'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({model_alias: 'fake-echo', kind: 'chat'})}).then(r => r.json()).then(t => { window.__tid = t.id; }); return 'creating a thread'; })()

label: a thread of its own
the Chat with the drive's own thread open

js: (() => { window.__shell = () => document.querySelector('.chat-shell'); window.__side = w => document.querySelector(w === 'list' ? '.chat-shell > .dock.left' : '.chat-shell .dock.right'); window.__open = w => { const d = __side(w); return !!d && d.classList.contains('drawer') && d.classList.contains('peek') && !!d.querySelector(':scope > .dock-side'); }; window.__btn = w => document.querySelector('.chat-head .chat-drawer-btn[data-drawer="' + (w === 'list' ? 'Conversations' : 'Thread settings') + '"]'); window.__r = el => el.getBoundingClientRect(); window.__on_top = el => { const r = __r(el); const hit = document.elementFromPoint(r.left + r.width / 2, r.top + r.height / 2); return !!hit && el.contains(hit); }; return 'helpers'; })()
